theorem lg_target : (CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.monomorphisms (Type u)).IsStableUnderCobaseChange := by
  intro f g
  let P := pushout f g
  let i₁ := pushout.i1
  let i₂ := pushout.i2
  let h := pushout.map (id _)
  let cobase_change_map := i₂
  haveI : IsInjective (cobase_change_map) :=
    begin
      rw CategoryTheory.Monoid.is_monomorphism_iff_is_injective,
      apply injective_of_pushout_injective,
      exact (f).is_monomorphism.injective,
    end
  exact cobase_change_map.is_monomorphism
